customizeItems.title: Proven Performance
customizeItems.description: Every Ironside PC is carefully built to deliver balanced, reliable performance for gaming, creative work, and everyday tasks. Each system undergoes extended testing to ensure stability and longevity, even after years of intense usage.

customizeItems.title: Built Tough
customizeItems.description: We back our gaming PCs with a 3 year parts and lifetime labor Ironside Warranty, free of charge. Our goal: build top-tier creative and gaming rigs with lasting quality.

customizeItems.title: Protect your Investment
customizeItems.description: Every Ironside PC is double boxed with instafoam to keep components secure. This secure packaging is one of the ways we go the extra mile in our PC building process.

page.aboutIntro: Ironside has been a family-run company for almost 16 years, creating products that represent the individuality of gamers of all kinds. We've kept it pretty simple: we make things we would want to own. That shows up in our thoughtful designs, our meticulous build quality, and our super friendly support team behind every machine.
page.aboutDescriptionLeft: Co-founded by four siblings and grounded in a shared passion for gaming, thoughtful design, and creating things we love.

items.title: Proven Performance
items.description: Every Ironside PC is carefully built to deliver balanced, reliable performance for gaming, creative work, and everyday tasks. Each system undergoes extended testing to ensure stability and longevity, even after years of intense usage.

items.title: Backed by Warranty
items.description: We stand behind our gaming computers with an unrivaled, 3 year parts and lifetime labor Ironside Warranty at no additional charge.

items.title: Shipped with Care
items.description: Every Ironside PC is carefully packaged to arrive safely at your door. We use double boxing and custom internal packaging to keep components secure during transit, so your system arrives exactly as intended.

items.title: Built by Family. Powered by Passion.
items.description: We’re more than a gaming PC company. We’re a family. Founded by four siblings, Ironside has always been a personal project, built with love, care, and respect for craftsmanship. What started in a Las Vegas garage is now a company still run with the same hands-on spirit and attention to detail.
